description: We are a team of B.Tech Engineering students. Our skills cover full-stack web development (MERN), backend and system design, AI and computer vision. Our team has has built many full-stack and AI projects. We are interested in scalable, backend-heavy systems and in turning complex data into tools people can use. The Lunar Landing Site Navigator fits that: we took expert-only ephemeris and terrain data and made it clear and fast for planners, educators and the public.
